notes.title: Biorage 1.1 UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hello!



It's time for some biorage!



The next few days, I'll be posting daily stuff about this game like sales, wishlists, opinions, speedrun strategy's etc as a sort of resurgence you might say.



Anyways today a quick little hotfix.



-- Tried to fix a shotgun bug that caused the game to crash after shooting it in chapter 1 level 3. (if it does still crash for some reason, a simple restart will 100 percent fix it)



-- Fixed the UI sprite for the "Random Mode" not appearing in the Extra Modes menu.



Update size: 47,6MB
